Sumptuous Hotels is a company that owns and runs a worldwide chain of hotels.
The company has an intranet for use by the managers and booking staff. They use it to transfer
information about bookings and available rooms between hotels.
The hotels have facilities for disabled persons in many rooms.
The company has a website that allows customers to research and book accommodation
online. The online booking system has facilities for use by disabled persons.
Each hotel room has an entertainment system for guests to watch television programmes or
listen to radio. Guests can also access the hotel’s video-on-demand system.
Guests may use their own MP3 players or CD players to listen to music by connecting the
players to the entertainment system in their room.
The hotel managers have asked market researchers to carry out research into the guests’ use
of the entertainment system to find out how the entertainment system might be improved so that
more guests will use it.
Each hotel room has internet access for use by the guests. Internet access in each room is
provided by WiFi or fixed cabling with sockets in the room.
